Policies and Initiatives.title: Data governance framework being developed for AI systems to reduce bias, strengthen data security: Gujarat govt
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Gujarat government is developing a data governance framework for AI systems to reduce bias and strengthen data security. This framework aims to ensure the responsible use of AI and protect sensitive information. The initiative is part of the government's efforts to promote trustworthy AI systems.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Centre’s ISM 2.0 to turbocharge Guj’s semicon industry
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Indian government's ISM 2.0 initiative is expected to boost Gujarat's semiconductor industry. The program aims to accelerate the growth of the sector in the state, although specific details are not provided. Gujarat is poised to benefit from the central government's efforts to promote the semiconductor industry through ISM 2.0.

Policies and Initiatives.title: MoU Exchanged to Establish Krishnamurthy Tandon School of Artificial Intelligence at IIM Ahmedabad
Policies and Initiatives.summary: A Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) has been exchanged to establish the Krishnamurthy Tandon School of Artificial Intelligence at IIM Ahmedabad. This new school will focus on artificial intelligence and is named after its benefactors. The establishment aims to promote research and education in the field of AI.

Policies and Initiatives.title: 1cr outlay for AI in Ahmedabad civic schools
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Ahmedabad civic body has allocated Rs 1 crore for the implementation of artificial intelligence in its schools. This initiative aims to enhance the education system and provide students with exposure to AI technology. The allocation is part of the civic body's efforts to modernize and improve the quality of education in its schools.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Now, AI to identify stray cattle in Ahmedabad, track owners
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Ahmedabad city administration is utilizing AI technology to identify stray cattle and track their owners. This initiative aims to address the issue of stray cattle roaming the streets, causing accidents and other problems. The AI system will help authorities to locate and reunite the stray cattle with their owners.

Events.title: Digital India Awareness Workshop on India AI Impact Summit 2026 and Digital India Initiatives in Daman & Diu
Events.summary: A Digital India Awareness Workshop was held in Daman & Diu to promote the India AI Impact Summit 2026 and Digital India Initiatives. The workshop aimed to raise awareness about the government's digital initiatives and their impact on the region. The event focused on the India AI Impact Summit 2026, highlighting its significance in promoting artificial intelligence in India.

Major AI Developments.title: Uber to set up its first India data centre with Adani Group
Major AI Developments.summary: Uber is setting up its first data centre in India in partnership with Adani Group, deepening its technology and infrastructure footprint in the country. The development was announced by Uber CEO Dara Khosrowshahi after meeting Gautam Adani in Ahmedabad. The facility will enable Uber to test and deploy technology at scale from India for its global operations.

Major AI Developments.title: Air India AI 171 crash probe in final stage, report likely in a month: Aviation minister Rammohan Naidu
Major AI Developments.summary: The investigation into the Air India flight AI 171 crash, which occurred on June 12, 2025, and claimed 260 lives, is in its final stage. The Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau's report is expected to be released within a month, according to Union Civil Aviation Minister Rammohan Naidu. The crash resulted in the loss of 241 lives on board and 19 on the ground.

Major AI Developments.title: Soon, AI app to guide drivers to empty parking slots in Ahmedabad
Major AI Developments.summary: An AI-powered app is being developed to guide drivers to empty parking slots in Ahmedabad. The app will utilize real-time data from CCTVs installed at 135 locations to provide accurate parking information. This initiative aims to simplify the parking process and reduce congestion in the city.

Major AI Developments.title: JobsUPI raises pre-seed round from IIMA Ventures and others
Major AI Developments.summary: JobsUPI, a multilingual employment platform, has raised $250K in a pre-seed funding round from IIMA Ventures and several angel investors. The funds will be used to enhance product capabilities, scale distribution, and expand into new geographies. JobsUPI aims to improve access to jobs across India with its Voice AI-powered platform, co-founded by Shrey Bansal and Shubham Periwal in 2025.

Major AI Developments.title: GCCI expo focuses on semiconductors, deep tech
Major AI Developments.summary: The GCCI expo highlighted semiconductors and deep tech, showcasing key areas of focus. The event likely brought together industry experts and innovators to discuss advancements and opportunities in these fields. Semiconductors and deep tech were the primary areas of emphasis at the expo.

Major AI Developments.title: 71 students part of first BPGP-BA&AI batch at IIM Ah
Major AI Developments.summary: The Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad (IIM-A) has introduced its first batch of Business Analytics and Artificial Intelligence (BA&AI) under the BPGP program. A total of 71 students are part of this inaugural batch. The BPGP-BA&AI program aims to equip students with skills in business analytics and artificial intelligence.

Major AI Developments.title: Gujarat police introduce AI tool to sharpen NDPS probes, boost conviction rates
Major AI Developments.summary: Gujarat police have introduced an AI tool to enhance investigations under the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) Act. The tool aims to sharpen probes and boost conviction rates by analyzing evidence and providing insights. This initiative is expected to improve the effectiveness of NDPS cases in the state.

Major AI Developments.title: Gujarat govt plans to deploy AI to detect ITC scams in GST
Major AI Developments.summary: The Gujarat government plans to utilize artificial intelligence (AI) to detect Input Tax Credit (ITC) scams in the Goods and Services Tax (GST) system. This initiative aims to prevent tax evasion and improve the overall efficiency of the tax collection process. The AI system will help identify potential scams and anomalies in GST returns.

Major AI Developments.title: World Health Day: AI now powers diagnoses, surgeries at top hospitals in Ahmedabad
Major AI Developments.summary: Top hospitals in Ahmedabad are now utilizing AI to power diagnoses and surgeries. This integration of AI technology is enhancing the quality of healthcare services in the city. AI-powered systems are being used to support medical professionals in making accurate diagnoses and performing complex surgeries.

Major AI Developments.title: Spacetech startup SatLeo Labs raises $2.2 Mn in seed round
Major AI Developments.summary: Spacetech startup SatLeo Labs has raised $2.2 million in a seed funding round, led by Unicorn India Ventures, bringing its total funding to $5.5 million. The round also saw participation from other investors, including Merak Ventures and Java Capital. The funds will be used to advance its thermal satellite mission and scale its AI-powered platform for thermal intelligence applications.

Major AI Developments.title: BJP councillor files defamation case over ‘AI video’, AAP candidate booked
Major AI Developments.summary: A BJP councillor has filed a defamation case over a video created using artificial intelligence. The case was filed against an AAP candidate, who has been booked in connection with the matter. The video allegedly contained defamatory content, prompting the councillor to take legal action.

Major AI Developments.title: Satark AI raises pre-seed round at $4 Mn valuation
Major AI Developments.summary: Satark AI, a cybersecurity startup, has raised an undisclosed amount in a pre-seed funding round at a $4 million valuation cap from angel investors. The company had previously secured funding at a $3 million valuation cap in October last year. The new funds will be used to run pilots with enterprise-grade and growth-stage companies to validate the platform's impact on security operations.

Major AI Developments.title: HC comes out with policy for AI use
Major AI Developments.summary: The High Court has introduced a policy for the use of Artificial Intelligence. This policy aims to regulate and guide the implementation of AI within the court's operations. The details of the policy can be found in a recent article on the Times of India website.

Major AI Developments.title: AI school inaugurated at IIM Ahmedabad
Major AI Developments.summary: An AI school has been inaugurated at the Indian Institute of Management (IIM) Ahmedabad. The establishment of the AI school aims to promote research and education in the field of artificial intelligence. This initiative is expected to enhance the institute's capabilities in AI and related technologies.

Major AI Developments.title: Art, science and tech converge at IIT-Gn curiosity conference
Major AI Developments.summary: The Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar (IIT-Gn) hosted a curiosity conference where art, science, and technology converged. The event brought together various disciplines to foster innovation and exploration. The conference showcased the intersection of art, science, and tech, promoting a culture of curiosity and creativity.

Major AI Developments.title: Magical Nest operator Raanro raises pre-seed round
Major AI Developments.summary: Raanro Interior Technology, the parent company of Magical Nest, has raised Rs 4.12 crore in a pre-seed funding round at a pre-money valuation of Rs 60 crore. The round was participated by Stargazer Fund and several angel investors, including Kunal Shah and Ankit Nagori. The company will use the funds to develop an AI-powered platform for streamlining interior design workflows.

Major AI Developments.title: Ahmedabad police nab 7 in Rs 2.4 crore fake currency racket; AI tools and Chinese-sourced paper used to forge Rs 500 notes
Major AI Developments.summary: Ahmedabad police have arrested 7 individuals involved in a Rs 2.4 crore fake currency racket, where AI tools and Chinese-sourced paper were used to forge Rs 500 notes. The counterfeit notes were seized by the crime branch, highlighting the use of advanced technology in the forgery. The operation has led to the dismantling of a significant fake currency network.

Major AI Developments.title: New hostel to come up at AI 171 crash site: Gujarat govt
Major AI Developments.summary: The Gujarat government has announced plans to build a new hostel at the site of the Air India 171 crash. The project aims to commemorate the incident and provide accommodation facilities. The hostel's construction is a part of the government's efforts to develop the area.

Major AI Developments.title: Lumikai leads $1.5 Mn seed round in NPrep
Major AI Developments.summary: NPrep, an AI-powered skilling platform for nursing students and professionals, has raised $1.5 million in a seed funding round led by Lumikai. The round also saw participation from existing investor All In Capital and other investors, including Velo Partners and angel investors. This funding follows a previous pre-seed round led by All In Capital, with the amount undisclosed.

Major AI Developments.title: ‘Gandhi’s Dictionary’ to enter AI age with 2,200 new words
Major AI Developments.summary: Gandhi's Dictionary is being updated to enter the AI age with the addition of 2,200 new words. The dictionary, which originally contained words related to Mahatma Gandhi's life and teachings, will now include modern terms to reflect the changing times. The updated dictionary aims to make Gandhi's philosophy and ideas more accessible and relevant in the digital era.

Major AI Developments.title: 'Injected anaesthetic drug': Two college friends die by suicide inside Gujarat temple washroom; used ChatGPT to find ways, say cops
Major AI Developments.summary: Two 18- and 20-year-old college friends were found dead in a temple washroom in Surat, Gujarat, after allegedly injecting themselves with anesthetic drugs. Police found evidence of drug vials, syringes, and mobile phone data showing searches for suicide methods, including the use of ChatGPT. The girls had left for college but did not return home, leading to the discovery of their bodies.

Major AI Developments.title: AI effect? Helplines no longer ringingoff the hook with student distress calls
Major AI Developments.summary: Student helplines are receiving fewer distress calls, potentially due to the impact of AI. This trend suggests that AI may be helping students cope with their issues, reducing the need for human support. The decline in calls indicates a significant shift in how students are managing their emotional and academic struggles.

Major AI Developments.title: Gujarat Board exams: Swadesh, AI and India of My Dreams were essay topics on Class 10 language papers
Major AI Developments.summary: The Gujarat Board exams featured essay topics on Class 10 language papers, including "Swadesh", "AI", and "India of My Dreams". These topics were part of the recent exams, with "Swadesh" and "India of My Dreams" likely focusing on patriotism and national aspirations, while "AI" touched on artificial intelligence. The inclusion of these topics reflects the board's effort to engage students with contemporary issues and ideas.

Major AI Developments.title: Obesity experts discuss AI, apps to track diet at conference in Ahmedabad
Major AI Developments.summary: Obesity experts gathered at a conference in Ahmedabad to discuss the role of AI and apps in tracking diet. The conference explored how technology can aid in monitoring and managing diet to combat obesity. Experts shared insights on the potential of AI-powered tools to support weight management and healthy eating habits.

Major AI Developments.title: AI crash: Ahmedabad civic body to receive Rs 16 lakh refreshments bill for search and debris-clearance teams
Major AI Developments.summary: The Ahmedabad civic body is expected to receive a Rs 16 lakh refreshments bill for search and debris-clearance teams following an AI crash. The bill is for the expenses incurred during the search and clearance operations. The civic body will have to bear the cost of refreshments provided to the teams involved in the operation.

Major AI Developments.title: Gujarat HC flags AI-generated case law in GST order
Major AI Developments.summary: The Gujarat High Court has identified AI-generated case law in a Goods and Services Tax (GST) order. This incident highlights the potential issue of artificial intelligence-generated content being used in legal proceedings. The court's observation raises concerns about the authenticity and reliability of AI-generated case law in judicial decisions.

Major AI Developments.title: CWG blueprint: AI, renewables, legacy assets are key points
Major AI Developments.summary: The CWG blueprint highlights key points including the integration of AI, the use of renewables, and the utilization of legacy assets. These elements are expected to play a crucial role in the development and implementation of the plan. The blueprint aims to incorporate innovative technologies and sustainable practices to achieve its objectives.

Major AI Developments.title: Organizations launch AI in healthcare declaration in Ahmedabad
Major AI Developments.summary: Organizations have launched an AI in healthcare declaration in Ahmedabad, marking a significant step towards integrating artificial intelligence in the healthcare sector. The declaration aims to promote the use of AI in healthcare to improve patient outcomes and enhance the overall quality of care. This initiative is expected to revolutionize the healthcare industry by leveraging AI technology.

Major AI Developments.title: AI desperate for linguists, but state univs miss the prompt
Major AI Developments.summary: The AI industry is facing a shortage of linguists, but state universities are not adequately responding to the demand. As a result, the industry is struggling to find skilled professionals to meet its needs. State universities are missing the opportunity to provide relevant training and education in linguistics to support the growing AI sector.

Major AI Developments.title: Air India, AI Express to shift domestic ops to T2 from March 29
Major AI Developments.summary: Air India and AI Express will shift their domestic operations to Terminal 2 from March 29. The move is part of the airlines' efforts to streamline their operations and improve passenger experience. The change will take effect on March 29, with all domestic flights operating from Terminal 2 thereafter.

Major AI Developments.title: Gujarat: OpenAI partners with IIM-A, others for AI collaboration and applications
Major AI Developments.summary: OpenAI has partnered with the Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad (IIM-A) and other organizations to collaborate on AI applications. The partnership aims to explore and develop various AI-related projects and initiatives. This collaboration is expected to drive AI innovation and adoption in the region.

Major AI Developments.title: Adani Group to invest $100 billion in renewable-powered AI data centres by 2035
Major AI Developments.summary: Adani Group will invest $100 billion by 2035 to build renewable-energy-powered data centres for Artificial Intelligence (AI) workloads. This investment marks one of India's largest private commitments to digital infrastructure. The data centres will be powered by renewable energy, supporting the growth of AI in the country.

Major AI Developments.title: SPV formed to advance research activities at AI CoE in Gujarat’GIFT City
Major AI Developments.summary: A Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) has been formed to advance research activities at the Artificial Intelligence Centre of Excellence (AI CoE) in Gujarat's GIFT City. The move aims to promote research and development in the field of artificial intelligence. The SPV will facilitate collaboration and innovation at the AI CoE, driving growth and advancement in the sector.

Major AI Developments.title: ‘Sarlaben’ AI rolled out to help 36 lakh dairy farmers
Major AI Developments.summary: An AI system called "Sarlaben" has been launched to assist approximately 36 lakh dairy farmers. The system aims to provide support and guidance to dairy farmers, although specific details of its functionality are not provided. The rollout of Sarlaben AI is intended to benefit a large number of dairy farmers in the country.

Major AI Developments.title: IIT Gandhinagar develops AI framework for pollen image classification
Major AI Developments.summary: IIT Gandhinagar has developed an AI framework for classifying pollen images, utilizing artificial intelligence technology. The framework is designed to improve the accuracy of pollen image classification, which can have various applications in fields such as botany and environmental science. This development is a significant achievement in the field of AI research and its potential applications.

Major AI Developments.title: From cowsheds to cloud: Amul Diary launches AI assistant ‘Sarlaben’
Major AI Developments.summary: Amul Dairy has launched an AI assistant named 'Sarlaben' to enhance its operations. The AI assistant is expected to improve efficiency and productivity in the dairy's various functions. Sarlaben marks a significant technological advancement for Amul, transitioning from traditional cowsheds to cloud-based services.

Major AI Developments.title: IIM-A gets Rs 100cr endowment to establish school of AI
Major AI Developments.summary: The Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad (IIM-A) has received a Rs 100cr endowment to establish a school of artificial intelligence (AI). This significant funding will enable the institute to set up a dedicated school focused on AI research and education. The endowment is expected to enhance IIM-A's capabilities in the field of AI and related technologies.

Major AI Developments.title: Saved by seconds: ISR working on AI-based quake early warning system for Gujarat
Major AI Developments.summary: The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISR) is developing an AI-based earthquake early warning system for Gujarat. The system aims to provide critical seconds of warning to people in the event of an earthquake, potentially saving lives. The AI technology will help detect seismic activity and alert authorities and the public quickly.

Major AI Developments.title: Tatas to make chips, laptops for Intel in Gujarat, Assam
Major AI Developments.summary: Tata Electronics will manufacture Intel's advanced AI laptop chips and employ cutting-edge packaging technologies at its new facilities in Gujarat and Assam. This collaboration aims to boost India's semiconductor ambitions and enhance cost-effectiveness for Intel. The partnership will also accelerate market entry for Intel, capitalizing on India's growing AI PC demand.

AI Start-Up News.title: How this deeptech startup is driving seaweed cultivation along the western coast of India
AI Start-Up News.summary: ClimaCrew, a Mumbai-based deeptech startup, is promoting seaweed cultivation along India's western coast by partnering with coastal communities and industries. The company uses an AI-driven platform to analyze satellite data and identify suitable locations for seaweed cultivation. This initiative aims to harness the nutritional potential of seaweed in Gujarat and Maharashtra.
